Anne L: quick heads-up — joint telemetry demo w/ Datadog + SI on Wed. Need final dashboard bundle and sampling guidance. can someone own the smoke run Tue 11am PT? :calendar:

Josh P: I can run it but need the dashboard JSON and a sample trace payload. where are artifacts?

Anne L: uploading bundle to S3 now: s3://redwood-partners/telemetry/handoff/1716612345/dashboard-bundle.tar.gz

Devon R: tagging in the dashboard delta — main change is the GPU memory timeseries and span name mapping. watch out for name collisions with internal services.

Sara K: Also add a note for OTLP exporter env var. quick snippet:

```
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=https://otel.redwood.ai/v1/traces
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=redwood-demo
OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=deployment.environment=demo
```

Leo M: For sampling, recommend head-based sampling at 0.5 and stable tail-sample of 0.05 for long-running batches. we'll include a sampling policy file in the bundle.

Anne L: perfect. @Josh P can you run the smoke with the bundle and paste the last 10 lines of the agent log here after?

Josh P: yep; I'll run Tue 11am PT and report back. pushing checklist now: deploy demo, run synthetic trace, load dashboard, verify 50 traces show up, confirm span tags, confirm panels render.

datadog-bot: integration-check: dashboard ingest OK, trace-forwarding latency < 200ms in eu-west-1. :white_check_mark:

Josh P: smoke run done. logs:

```
2024-04-24T18:11:05Z agent: connected to otel endpoint
2024-04-24T18:11:07Z exporter: batch sent 50 traces
2024-04-24T18:11:09Z dashboard: panels loaded
```

Anne L: awesome. last step: marketing needs a 1-paragraph blurb and a screenshot. Sara can you take a polished screenshot? :camera:

Sara K: on it. will upload to the handoff folder and ping legal for review.

Anne L: thanks team. I'll schedule the final dress rehearsal for Wed 9am PT.
